integrity: The proof combines the published odd-exponent parametrization with Fine-Wilf. A standalone checker enumerates binary and ternary finite cases, verifies the count formula, relation symmetry, and the arithmetic Fine-Wilf threshold.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to equal-length primitive factors. It uses the published equal-length product parametrization and ordered-pair count; the new content is the global maximum-degree-one consequence. No unequal-length matching claim is made.
title: Equal-length primitive nonprimitive-product graphs are matchings
